reuse.why: Uses the existing extractTagsFromText for #fixed detection, getSheetValue/setBudget/batchMessages, and the goal_def column templates are stored in.

duplication.why: The four copied category queries are replaced by one getBulkActionCategories helper used by every month-wide action; only the per-action income/tracking skip remains repeated, as before.

placement.why: The eligibility rule lives in a single private helper in budget/actions.ts next to the actions, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes are limited to month-wide action selection, the new action and its registration, and tests.

maintainability.why: A single documented selection helper with a typed options object makes the hidden, template and #fixed rules easy to find and change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg and setLastMonthSpending all call getBulkActionCategories

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkActionCategories gains one includeHiddenCategories option expressed in its SQL; every month-wide action routes through it
